# A.U.R.A.

Name: A.U.R.A.

Developer: CodeCrafters

Website:

License:
MIT

Summary:
A.U.R.A. is an open-source desktop AI assistant for Windows that combines real-time voice interaction, intelligent automation, computer control, local AI support, and productivity features while prioritizing user privacy.
